question: The prayers on __________ are supposed to be in the community mosque, and are known as the Jumma Namaz.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Friday**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Friday** is the day when Jumma Namaz is performed in the community mosque.
 
• Jumma Namaz is a congregational prayer that Muslims hold every Friday, just after noon instead of the Zuhr prayer.
 
• It is considered one of the most exalted Islamic rituals and one of its obligatory acts.
 
• The significance of Friday is highlighted in the Quran in Surah Al-Jumu'ah, verse 9, which calls for the faithful to leave off business and gather for the prayers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The term **Jumma** derives from the Arabic word for Friday, which is the sixth day of the Islamic week.
 
• Friday is considered a special day for Muslims, often referred to as the "weekly Eid".
 
• Many Muslims prepare for Jumma prayers by taking a special bath, wearing clean clothes, and applying perfume.
 
• The Friday prayer is led by an Imam, who usually delivers a sermon (Khutbah) before the prayer.
 
• Attending the Jumma prayer is considered mandatory for adult male Muslims, while women may attend but are not required to do so.
